whoBody:
To join as an official member of the PCYD you must be a Putnam County Resident between 18  and 40 years old or a student between 14 and 18 with a parent or guardians permission. 

If you are interested but unsure whether you qualify, reach out. We would rather answer your question than lose a potential member.
ctaBody: Come to our next monthly meeting or reach out directly.
expectBody:
PCYD is still in its founding phase. That means the people who get involved now will have a direct hand in shaping the organization's structure, priorities, and culture. Early participants should expect regular meetings, a collaborative atmosphere, and real responsibility.

This is not a social club. PCYD is building toward concrete goals: filling precinct seats, running voter engagement operations, and creating a pipeline of trained local Democratic leaders. If that appeals to you, you are in the right place.
heroBody: There are several ways to participate, whether you want to lead, volunteer, or simply stay connected.

waysCards.title: Become a Founding Member
waysCards.body: Sign the charter packet and help establish PCYD as a recognized chapter of the Florida Young Democrats. Founding members shape the organization from the ground up and are recognized in our charter documents.

waysCards.title: Volunteer
waysCards.body: Help with event logistics, voter registration drives, outreach, and community engagement. No prior political experience required. We will train you.

waysCards.title: Run for a Precinct Seat
waysCards.body: Democratic Precinct Committeeman and Committeewoman seats carry formal voting authority within the county party structure. PCYD will help eligible members understand the process and prepare to qualify.

waysCards.title: Support as an Ally
waysCards.body: Not in the 14 to 39 age range? You can still support PCYD as an ally by attending events, sharing our work, and connecting us with resources in the community.
